SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT alert_group_id AS alert_group_key, alert_group_code, alert_group_description, display_text, sort_order, is_active FROM alertGroup
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimsprocessing.gold.gold_dimalertgroup t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON s.alert_group_key = t.alert_group_key WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET alert_group_code = s.alert_group_code, alert_group_description = s.alert_group_description, display_text = s.display_text, sort_order = s.sort_order, is_active = s.is_active WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (alert_group_key, alert_group_code, alert_group_description, display_text, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (s.alert_group_key, s.alert_group_code, s.alert_group_description, s.display_text, s.sort_order, s.is_active)
